posts.subject: HZ går bara till 165??
posts.author: Sannya08
posts.message_html: Just bought a Lenovo Legion 27Q-10 OLED, it says it should be able to go up to 240 Hz but when I try to change it, it only lets me set it to 165 Hz. I'm using the DisplayPort cable that came with the package. Does anyone know how I can fix this??
posts.message_text: Just bought a Lenovo Legion 27Q-10 OLED, it says it should be able to go up to 240 Hz but when I try to change it, it only lets me set it to 165 Hz. I'm using the DisplayPort cable that came with the package. Does anyone know how I can fix this??

posts.subject: Re:Hz only goes up to 165??
posts.author: Hector_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hi Sannya08!

Welcome to Lenovo Community. I understand you're trying to use 240 Hz on your Legion 27Q-10 OLED and Windows is only showing up to 165 Hz, even with the included DisplayPort cable.

If 240 Hz is available for your setup, a few things can affect whether Windows shows it: the connection type in use, the current display resolution, the graphics settings, and whether the refresh rate is being checked in both Windows display settings and your graphics control panel. It can also help to reseat the cable firmly on both ends and test another known-good high-bandwidth cable or port if available.

Also, in monitor's OSD Menu, set DSC to disable and check again if you can adjust the refresh rate afterwards.

We will wait for your reply.

Best regards,
Hector_Lenovo
